### Praying for Keeps
Author: Dr. James Dobson
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/daily-devotions-for-parents-by-dr-james-dobson/dr-dobson-s-parenting-devotional-sept-5.html
Passage: John 16:24
Points:
- Jesus invites believers to ask so their joy may be full and complete.
- Parents should pray with steadfast persistence and confidence for their children, even through years of rebellion.
- God faithfully answers enduring prayers by placing key people at pivotal moments in loved ones' lives.
- Believers are called never to give up praying when faced with fatigue or discouragement.

### The Peace of Jesus
Author: Billy Graham
Site: Billy Graham Evangelistic Association
URL: https://billygraham.org/devotions/the-peace-of-jesus
Passage: John 16:33
Points:
- The peace offered by Christ is a deep spiritual peace, not worldly appeasement or compromise.
- Human efforts, negotiations, and secular institutions are unable to produce ultimate peace.
- Genuine peace is freely given to anyone who chooses to place their trust in Jesus.
- Believers can find courage amid earthly storms knowing Christ has conquered the world.
